name: Price of Fame
oracle_text:
This spell costs {2} less to cast if it targets a legendary creature.
Destroy target creature.
Surveil 2. (Look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)
blocked_sentences: This spell costs {2} less to cast if it targets a legendary creature

needs.what: a card-level `cost_reduction` gated on the spell's OWN chosen targets, e.g. `{"amount": 2, "targeting": {"types": ["Creature"], "supertypes": ["Legendary"]}}`, so the spell costs {2} less exactly when one of its declared targets matches the selector; `reduction_amount(card.cost_reduction)` in engine/cost_reduction.py needs the cast's `targets`, which `cost_reduction()` already receives and passes to `spell_mana_tax`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cost_reduction` takes `amount` plus a `condition`, but `reduction_amount` is target-blind and the loader narrows `condition` to heads answerable at pricing time, none of which reads the spell's targets. `condition: {exists: legendary creature}` would discount the spell whenever any legendary creature is on the battlefield even if it targets a nonlegendary one. The `spell_cost_reduction` static's targeting clause reads targets but discounts other spells from a permanent, not the card itself
